'''Z-Omega group''' was a group of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] that served the [[Zaarin coup forces]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. It was present at the [[Attack on Omar|First Battle of Omar]].
